title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — second sense: where/when is the declaration?
pass_a_gloss: If the second sense: name the place and the hour of that external sentence—and say whether it landed outside us or inside us.
pass_b_english: If the second, where and when was that declaration made, and is it outside us, or inside us? The learned man does not say.
source_text: Si secundum, ubi & quando facta est illa declaratio, & num extra nos, an intra nos?
notes: Cap. IX senses densify section 522 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 328–329 tip).
